teacherRows.note: Seven instructor-only lessons cover RANGE, MODE, synthetic MARK, §1.21 Trip Source, §4.9 receiver absence, §2.3 Key Beep and §1.3 BRILL using semantic input sequences, per-attempt session hash, negative/cancel/retry and replay. Lesson05 rejects temporary NAV-fixture activation; 06 requires committed Off-to-On source control; 07 requires two short POWER/BRILL actions and ENTER; unrelated FUNC down/cancel is rejected rather than ignored. Scoring is not authenticated anti-cheat, OEM certification or independent course approval.
